notes.title: New update
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

A small update today that improves the tutorial by adding a voice over to talk you through everything you need to know, and boots straight into the tutorial for first run to ensure everyone understands what the game is about.

Also some minor UI improvements to help readability while playing the games. Every time a monster is sent between players a little icon gets sent from one minimap to the other, so you can see in real time what monsters are going where. 

I'm looking to release the game soon so stay tuned for a release date announcement after some testing, and I get some steam requirements sorted for the store page.

notes.title: Update V0.0.55
notes.content:
We're currently working on a new map and have a list of QOL changes that need to be implemented, but I wanted to start development back up with a few easy wins, so here's a small patch :)

Still working hard on the game, but thanks to work commitments, updates will be sporadic for the time being. Sorry about that.

Patch Notes:

changed rocket speed from 5 to 7

fixed crosshair alignment (was 16 * 16 pixels off from center)

removed HUD scaling on lower resolutions that was messing with positioning

minimum mouse sensitivity is now 0.01, was previously 0.1

notes.title: Minimap improvement
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

The minimap has been improved in this update. Walls are now rendered on the radar so you can see the layout of the level. This also improves things in multiplayer as you can see exactly where the other player is.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39214540/04435073277a07a8a6598498d47a967e5481ec4d.jpg[/img]

The rocket launcher has also been buffed as it's damage output was not quite up to par with the Assault Rifle and Double Barrelled Shotgun.

[h2]Patch Notes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Cowmogorgon updated with final sprite with detailed sides.
[*] Minimap now renders walls for both local and remote player
[*] Rocket Launcher damage increased
[*] Lobby properly closes after victory. This should fix game crashes as someone tries to join while on Victory screen
[/list]

notes.title: Hello!
notes.content:
Hi There!

I will now be making community posts with every significant update. I quietly started up the steam page for Return to Sender and have been working away, posting updates to [url=https://twitter.com/GamesWreath]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCCz5u5wwxJlfxIIhu7ScJSw]Youtube [/url] and the [url=https://discord.gg/MkvKQqQt]GoldenWreathGames Discord[/url]. But it's about time I started posting updates on Steam too. 

[h2]State of the game[/h2]
Return to Sender currently has 2 levels, which can be played in single-player wave survival, or multiplayer. There are 3 enemies, and 7 weapons (8 if the kick counts?). The multiplayer is fully functional including LAN play, Public Matchmaking over Steam Lobbies, and Private matches over Steam Lobbies. 

[h2]What's left to do[/h2]
There is a lot of polish left to do, including replacing some WiP graphics and bug fixing. As for content. I'm honestly not sure what the finished game is going to look like. I will be adding at least 1 new level, and have plans for some more enemies. But my main priority really is polish over content right now.

There will definitely be Achievements added related to both the multiplayer and single-player mode as well as some steam stats integration, such as games played, games won ect.

[h2]Patch notes[/h2]

So with all that said? what did I actually upload today?
[list]
[*] Added a new weapon: Rocket Launcher.
[*] Fixed bug related to Steam lobbies not properly closing after switching to single player
[/list]
